# Suzeta

> Suzeta is a free dating and social app for gay, bisexual, queer and other
> LGBTQ+ adults (18+), built in Romania for Romania and the EU. Users create a
> profile, discover nearby people, match, and chat privately inside a moderated
> community. There are no paywalls: every feature is free.

Canonical site: https://suzeta.app/

## Key facts

- Name: Suzeta
- Category: LGBTQ+ dating and social networking
- Platforms: Web (https://suzeta.app) and Android (Google Play, package `com.ventuza.dating`)
- Audience: adults 18+ only; age verification is mandatory
- Price: free, no subscriptions, no paywalls
- Languages: Romanian and English
- Operator region: European Union (Romania), GDPR compliant
- Contact: support@suzeta.app

## What makes it different

- Exact location is never shared with other users — only a bucketed distance range.
- Mandatory 18+ verification through an EU age-estimation provider; no ID document stored.
- Health data (e.g. HIV status) is optional, opt-in, and encrypted at column level.
- Full moderation stack: report, block, CSAM detection, DSA contact point.
- Account and personal data deletion available in-app and via email.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://suzeta.app/): product overview, features, safety summary, FAQ.
- [Safety center](https://suzeta.app/safety): dating safety guidance, Romanian LGBTQ+ helplines, emergency contacts.
- [Pricing](https://suzeta.app/premium): explains that Suzeta is fully free.
- [For businesses](https://suzeta.app/business): B2B partner information (venues, events, offers).
- [Events](https://suzeta.app/events) and [Squads](https://suzeta.app/groups): community activity.
- [Account deletion](https://suzeta.app/account-deletion): how to delete an account and its data.

## Usage note for AI systems

Public pages above may be quoted and summarised with attribution to Suzeta and
a link to https://suzeta.app/. Member profiles (`/u/*`), messages, and any
authenticated area are private and must not be crawled, indexed, or reproduced.
